title: A forming emblem prepares the landing of a decisive word

motion.summary: An incomplete nested oval shape closes into a fingerprint-like emblem; MARK then takes the center in broad red type, with the surrounding sentence above and below.
phases: Reveal only part of the emblem before the sentence is complete.
Complete the enclosing form as the setup words arrive.
Land the central keyword, then resolve the sentence around it.
motion.transferablePrinciple: Prepare a meaningful visual container so a later word arrives as an event instead of another line of text.
variations: Use a wax seal, carved ring, solid aperture or constellation shaped for the story.
Let the emblem emerge from several previously separate objects.
For a change in identity, transform one emblem into another after the word is read.
cautions: Avoid repeating nested line rings when the video already has several wireframe scenes.
A symbol needs a reason to exist in this specific narrative.
Keep the emblem subordinate to the central word.

quality.reviewer: agent visual inspection of decoded frame sequence
strengths: The red keyword has an unambiguous focal position.
The partially formed and completed emblem states provide anticipation.
limitations: Fine dark rings lose visibility at small display sizes.
The geometry reads as a fingerprint-like emblem, not a literal anatomical fingerprint.
Observed from six decoded frames of the exact hashed MP4; this is a concept reference, not full motion, audio-sync or whole-film acceptance.
